Desktop OS.reason_en: Vim netrw plugin flaw enables arbitrary script and shell command execution via crafted filenames containing quote characters.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Vim netrw 插件漏洞允许攻击者通过包含引号的构造文件名执行任意脚本和 Shell 命令。

Desktop OS.reason_en: Dell Display Manager TOCTOU vulnerability allows low-privilege local users to escalate privileges and achieve code execution.

Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in the gvfs SFTP backend allows malicious servers to trigger out-of-bounds reads, potentially crashing desktop applications or leaking sensitive memory.

Desktop OS.reason_en: Integer overflow in GIMP's PVR plug-in enables heap-based buffer overflows when processing crafted image files, posing a direct risk for local code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PVR 插件存在整数溢出漏洞，在处理构造的图像文件时会引发基于堆的缓冲区溢出，直接导致本地代码执行风险。

Desktop OS.reason_en: Webmin's certificate issuance CGI fails to sanitize user-supplied DN fields, allowing authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary lines into system configuration files.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Webmin 证书颁发 CGI 模块未对用户提供的 DN 字段进行过滤，允许已认证管理员向系统配置文件中注入任意内容。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical authorization flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, directly compromising enterprise desktop environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation, directly compromising enterprise desktop environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在关键授权漏洞，可导致基于网络的提权，直接威胁企业桌面环境安全。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows TPM allows local privilege escalation, undermining hardware-rooted security mechanisms on client devices.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows TPM allows local privilege escalation, undermining hardware-rooted security mechanisms on client devices.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows TPM 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地提权，破坏了客户端设备上的硬件信任根安全机制。

Desktop OS.reason: Out-of-bounds write in Windows LDAP poses a critical remote code execution risk targeting Active Directory environments, which are foundational to enterprise identity management.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows LDAP poses a critical remote code execution risk targeting Active Directory environments, which are foundational to enterprise identity management.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows LDAP 中的越界写入漏洞针对 Active Directory 环境构成严重的远程代码执行风险，而 AD 是企业身份管理的基础架构。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows SMB enables unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, continuing the historical exploitation pattern of SMB services.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows SMB enables unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, continuing the historical exploitation pattern of SMB services.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows SMB 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经认证的远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，延续了 SMB 服务长期存在的利用模式。

Desktop OS.reason: Print Spooler heap overflow allows unauthenticated remote code execution, maintaining the print service as a high-value target for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Print Spooler heap overflow allows unauthenticated remote code execution, maintaining the print service as a high-value target for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Print Spooler 堆溢出漏洞允许未经认证的远程代码执行，使打印服务持续成为横向移动与提权的高价值攻击目标。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical out-of-bounds write in the Windows Search component enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to endpoint integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical out-of-bounds write in the Windows Search component enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to endpoint integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Search 组件中存在关键越界写入漏洞，可在无需认证的情况下实现远程代码执行，对终端完整性构成严重威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: An untrusted search path vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Client allows network-based privilege escalation by manipulating DLL loading sequences.
Desktop OS.reason_en: An untrusted search path vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Client allows network-based privilege escalation by manipulating DLL loading sequences.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的非受信任搜索路径漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵 DLL 加载顺序实现基于网络的提权。

Desktop OS.reason: A heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel permits remote code execution through crafted documents, directly impacting end-user systems.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel permits remote code execution through crafted documents, directly impacting end-user systems.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造文档实现远程代码执行，直接威胁终端用户系统。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution via crafted documents, posing a critical threat to end-user workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution via crafted documents, posing a critical threat to end-user workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造文档实现远程代码执行，对终端用户工作站构成严重威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free flaw in PowerPoint allows unauthorized network-based code execution, frequently leveraged in targeted phishing campaigns.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in PowerPoint allows unauthorized network-based code execution, frequently leveraged in targeted phishing campaigns.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: PowerPoint 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，常被定向网络钓鱼攻击所利用。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap overflow in the Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service facilitates local privilege escalation, potentially compromising system integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service facilitates local privilege escalation, potentially compromising system integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service 中的堆溢出漏洞可辅助本地提权，进而可能破坏系统完整性。

Desktop OS.reason: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in Windows RPC runtime permits remote code execution across trusted internal networks.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in Windows RPC runtime permits remote code execution across trusted internal networks.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows RPC 运行库中的密码学签名验证绕过漏洞允许攻击者在可信的内部网络中执行远程代码。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical authentication bypass in Kerberos enables unauthorized network access and potential domain compromise without valid credentials.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in Kerberos enables unauthorized network access and potential domain compromise without valid credentials.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Kerberos 协议中存在关键认证绕过漏洞，可在无有效凭据的情况下实现未授权的网络访问及潜在的域渗透。

Desktop OS.reason: Flawed authorization checks in Active Directory Domain Services allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, risking widespread lateral movement.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Flawed authorization checks in Active Directory Domain Services allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, risking widespread lateral movement.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的授权检查缺陷允许攻击者远程执行任意代码，极易引发大规模的横向移动。

Desktop OS.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in NTFS permits remote code execution via specially crafted file system requests, bypassing standard isolation mechanisms.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: NTFS 中的非受信任指针解引用漏洞允许通过特制的文件系统请求实现远程代码执行，从而绕过标准隔离机制。

Desktop OS.reason_en: Inclusion of untrusted functionality in the Advanced Rasterization Platform facilitates local privilege escalation through the Windows graphics subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Advanced Rasterization Platform 中集成了非受信任功能，可通过 Windows 图形子系统辅助本地提权。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper input sanitization in the Windows Installer leads to insecure library loading, allowing locally authenticated users to gain elevated system privileges.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper input sanitization in the Windows Installer leads to insecure library loading, allowing locally authenticated users to gain elevated system privileges.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Installer 中的输入过滤不当会导致不安全的动态库加载，允许本地已认证用户获取高权限系统访问权。

Desktop OS.reason: SMB remains a primary attack vector for lateral movement; this race condition in the transport driver enables remote code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_en: SMB remains a primary attack vector for lateral movement; this race condition in the transport driver enables remote code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: SMB 仍是横向移动的主要攻击面；该传输驱动程序的竞争条件漏洞可实现远程代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: Print services are frequently targeted for initial access; path traversal here allows remote attackers to escalate privileges over the network.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Print services are frequently targeted for initial access; path traversal here allows remote attackers to escalate privileges over the network.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 打印服务常作为初始入侵的目标；此处存在的路径穿越漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络实现提权。

Desktop OS.reason: Compromises network configuration integrity by allowing adjacent attackers to execute code via the DHCP client service heap overflow.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Compromises network configuration integrity by allowing adjacent attackers to execute code via the DHCP client service heap overflow.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许同网段攻击者利用 DHCP 客户端服务的堆溢出执行代码，从而破坏网络配置完整性。

Desktop OS.reason: Extremely high severity across gaming and workstation networks, enabling unrestricted remote code execution through the Xbox Live networking stack.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Extremely high severity across gaming and workstation networks, enabling unrestricted remote code execution through the Xbox Live networking stack.

Desktop OS.reason: Widely deployed target for phishing campaigns, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code locally upon opening malicious documents.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Widely deployed target for phishing campaigns, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code locally upon opening malicious documents.

Desktop OS.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE via Color Management enables remote code execution across Windows endpoints, posing a severe threat to desktop security postures.

Desktop OS.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in Virtual Filtering Platform allows attackers to execute code remotely through manipulated network traffic targeting filtering drivers.

Desktop OS.reason: Unauthenticated network RCE in iSCSI service compromises storage networking infrastructure and grants full system control to remote attackers.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in iSCSI service compromises storage networking infrastructure and grants full system control to remote attackers.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: iSCSI 服务中的无需身份验证的网络远程代码执行漏洞会破坏存储网络基础设施，并使远程攻击者获得完全的系统控制权。

Desktop OS.reason: Unauthenticated network RCE in Windows Media Player highlights critical risks from crafted media files delivered over network boundaries.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Unauthenticated network RCE in Windows Media Player highlights critical risks from crafted media files delivered over network boundaries.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Media Player 中的无需身份验证的网络远程代码执行漏洞凸显了通过网络边界交付的构造媒体文件所带来的关键风险。

Desktop OS.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in LSASS directly threatens credential harvesting and domain compromise once initial authenticated access is achieved on an endpoint.

Desktop OS.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in LSASS allows local privilege escalation, potentially exposing cached credentials and domain secrets.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in LSASS allows local privilege escalation, potentially exposing cached credentials and domain secrets.

Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Color Management enables remote code execution via crafted media files, widely exploitable across user workstations.
